summary: A control machine with up to 64 tracks, each sending its Value through a mapping curve to a parameter of another machine (or out as MIDI controllers), gliding over Inertia; a track can mirror the one before it. It makes no sound of its own.
use_for: Drive parameters of other machines from track values through mapping curves.
quirks: It makes no sound of its own: each of up to 64 tracks sends its Value through a mapping curve to a parameter of another machine, or out as a MIDI controller; the targets and curves are set in its own settings window (no tool sets them).
The profile warns that it makes no sound from a MIDI note: it has no Note column and is not an instrument.
Value runs 0 to 65534 (percent of the target's range through the curve); Inertia is a glide in tenths of a tick (1280 is 128 ticks).
A slaved track mirrors the one before it, so a group of tracks can follow one control.

parameters.name: Inertia
parameters.description: Glide time in ticks/10 (0 = off, 10 = 1 tick, 1280 = 128 ticks). The glide to a new value; 0 is off
parameters.how: Sets the glide time to a new value, from 0 (off) to 128 ticks in tenths of a tick.
parameters.sound: Targets slide smoothly instead of jumping.

track_parameters.name: Slaved
track_parameters.description: Mirror the previous track's value (switch: 0=no, 1=yes). On a track after the first: it follows the track before
track_parameters.how: Makes this track mirror the previous track's value.
track_parameters.sound: Two tracks move together from one control.

track_parameters.name: Value
track_parameters.description: Control value (0 = 0%, 65534 = 100%) passed through the mapping curve
track_parameters.how: Sets the value sent through the track's mapping curve to its target, from 0 to 100 percent in 65535 steps.
track_parameters.sound: The target parameter moves across its range.
